one_line_description.value: Vercel is a platform for deploying, scaling, and securing frontend applications and agent workloads, combining developer experience with end-user performance.
one_line_description.quote: Vercel combines the best developer experience with an obsessive focus on end-user performance.

has_public_api.quote: | GET | `/v1/access-groups/{idOrName}` | Reads an access group | | POST | `/v1/access-groups/{idOrName}` | Update an access group | | DELETE | `/v1/access-groups/{idOrName}` | Deletes an access group |

api_type.quote: Every token request is a `POST` to `/v1/connect/token/:connector` on the Vercel API with a Bearer header and a JSON body that mirrors `ConnectTokenParams`.

api_breadth.value: REST, large surface: many resource groups (access groups, AI Gateway, bulk redirects, deployments, projects, webhooks), read-write with GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE operations
api_breadth.quote: | POST | `/ai-gateway/byok-credentials` | Create a BYOK credential | | GET | `/ai-gateway/byok-credentials/list` | List BYOK credentials |

auth_methods.quote: Every token request is a `POST` to `/v1/connect/token/:connector` on the Vercel API with a Bearer header and a JSON body that mirrors `ConnectTokenParams`.

oauth_scopes_documented.quote: Fine-grained scoping: Narrow each token with provider scopes, resource indicators, and rich authorization requests.

access_model.quote: | Plan | Price | Best for | | --- | --- | --- | | Hobby | $0/mo. | The perfect starting place for your web app. |

access_notes.value: Free self-serve Hobby plan is enough to create a Vercel access token and call the REST API; higher platform limits require Pro ($20/mo) and custom limits/quotas require Enterprise (contact the account team). Team RBAC roles determine what a token can do (view, mutate, attach, revoke per connector).
access_notes.quote: Enterprise: Contact your Vercel account team to request a limit increase.

official_mcp_server.quote: Vercel MCP, Vercel's hosted Model Context Protocol endpoint at `https://mcp.vercel.com`.

rate_limits.value: Documented as hard per-plan limits rather than request-rate quotas, e.g. deployments created per day: Hobby 100 / Pro 6000 / Enterprise custom; 200 projects on Hobby; request-level API rate limit numbers were not present in the retrieved text

webhooks.quote: Vercel Integrations allow you to subscribe to certain trigger-based events through webhooks.

sdk_languages.quote: The Vercel Connect SDKs (`@vercel/connect` for TypeScript and `vercel-connect` for Python) support two authentication methods, plus a separate path for dashboard and CLI users.

api_versioning_or_deprecation_notes.value: Path-versioned REST endpoints (e.g. /v1/...); deprecations are staged rather than cut off - a deprecated webhook event can no longer be added to integrations but continues to be delivered to existing subscribers, with changes tracked in the changelog.
api_versioning_or_deprecation_notes.quote: You can no longer add it to an integration webhook.

verdict_reason: Vercel publishes a broad, official REST API reference covering many resource groups with read-write endpoints (access groups, AI Gateway, bulk redirects, projects, deployments). Credentials are self-serve: a free Hobby plan is the documented starting point and access tokens are used as Bearer credentials, with Pro/Enterprise only needed for higher limits. Vercel also operates an official hosted MCP server at https://mcp.vercel.com.
open_questions: The Vercel access-tokens page (vercel.com/docs/accounts/access-tokens) and explicit API permission/scope documentation were not in the bundle, so auth_methods is limited to bearer_token; OAuth2 is documented only for Vercel MCP (and shown as OAUTH2/API_KEY in the Composio catalog), not for the REST API itself in the retrieved text.

Numeric request-level API rate limits live in a table on vercel.com/docs/limits whose rows were not captured in the retrieved text; only per-plan action limits (deployments/day, projects) were available.
sdk_languages reflects Vercel Connect SDKs only; no official general-purpose SDK for the Vercel REST API is documented in the bundle (AI SDK/Chat SDK are product SDKs in TypeScript).

No API sandbox/test-mode is documented in the bundle; Vercel's 'Sandbox' product is for isolated code execution, and preview deployments/staging are the practical test route (the staging KB guide was listed in search results but not fetched).
No community MCP servers were discovered; the MCP registry and GitHub checks returned no results.
Webhooks evidence is scoped to Vercel Integrations; whether all platform events are available to first-party (non-integration) consumers is not clear from the captured text.
